title: gilia gracilis var. congesta
intro: Gilia gracilis var. congesta, commonly known as Sticky Gilia or Sticky-leaved Gilia, is a perennial herb native to the western United States and southwestern Canada. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from anxiety, insomnia, and restlessness due to its adaptogenic and sedative effects. The bioactive constituents of Gilia gracilis var. congesta include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. The plant's health benefits also include its potential to support immune function, reduce stress, and promote relaxation.
